releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.50 adds My Places as a compact Library entry that opens a dedicated local places page. Places can keep a name, optional category, note, photo, GPS coordinates and a shared map link; Near Me requests location only when used and sorts saved GPS places by distance without background tracking. The shared Home/Files/Notes/Library header is tightened for smaller screens so the subtitle remains readable and the Settings action stays clean and consistent. Price Photos categories/duplicate protection, the Library/Inbox merge, and the stable Instagram Library/Gallery flow are preserved.
